rating.methodology_description: How AtlasFind produces transparent, source-linked and sponsor-independent ratings.
rating.editor_score_text: A structured score calculated from verified criteria, evidence and category-specific weights. It is published only after separate editor review and administrator approval.
rating.user_score_text: User ratings are stored separately and use a weighted average. Suspicious or unverified votes are excluded from the public aggregate.
rating.external_score_text: Ratings from app stores or review platforms are shown with their original scale, review count, source and check date. They are never disguised as an AtlasFind score.
rating.confidence_text: Confidence measures source coverage, freshness, evidence and independent approval. It does not secretly increase the product score.
rating.category_profiles_notice: Category profiles can change these weights. Every profile must total exactly 100%.
rating.independence_text: Sponsorship and paid partnerships are stored separately and cannot affect the formula, approval gate or organic ranking.
rating.update_policy_text: Every published rating includes methodology version, review date, next review date and change history. Methodology changes trigger a review queue instead of silently rewriting old scores.
rating.pending_review_text: This tool does not yet meet the minimum verified coverage and independent approval requirements. No unverified score is shown.
rating.manual_override_blocked: The overall score cannot be entered manually. It is recalculated from verified criteria and profile weights.
rating.community_description: This score comes from AtlasFind visitor votes and remains fully separate from the AtlasFind editorial score.
rating.score_saved: Your score was saved. Voting again from the same browser updates your previous score.
rating.editor_description: The AtlasFind score is calculated from features, ease of use, value, optimization and performance, security, platform support, freshness and transparency.
rating.catalog_score_description: A comparable score calculated automatically from verified information in the tool record.
rating.catalog_score_tooltip: Calculated automatically from verified catalog data; it is not a user or editor score.
rating.catalog_score_disclaimer: This score does not replace product security, speed or usability testing and is never mixed with user votes.
rating.catalog_score_methodology: The same formula applies to every tool: documented capability coverage 30%, platform and language accessibility 20%, pricing and usage flexibility 20%, verification and freshness transparency 20%, and record completeness 10%. Results use a ten-point scale. Human-reviewed editor scores and user scores remain separate.
rating.two_score_intro: The AtlasFind assessment and user ratings are never mixed. They are calculated and displayed separately.
rating.editor_method_features: Calculated from fixed criteria such as features, ease of use, value and optimization.
rating.editor_method_performance: Every criterion must be supported by a source, test or verified product information.
rating.editor_method_independent: Sponsors and paid partnerships cannot change the score.
rating.user_method_separate: User votes are kept completely separate from the AtlasFind assessment.
rating.user_method_weighted: A weighted average prevents a very small number of votes from being misleading.
rating.user_method_update: Voting again from the same browser updates the previous vote.
image.management_help: Only verified local files are published. Missing or unverified logos use a safe local initials fallback.
